Native clipboard history for macOS 14+, Apple Silicon.

- Deleting a card now takes ⌘⌫: a lone ⌫ no longer removes anything by accident.
- A right click on card text opens Encore's menu, now with its shortcuts, instead of the text menu.
- In the library, the keyboard cursor always stays in view, up and down, across days.
- Day headers in the library no longer overlap the cards scrolling beneath them.
- Day labels in the shelf sit at the bottom of their column.
- The selected card stands out more clearly.
- The bottom bar lists the shortcuts to search, favorite and delete.

Download the ZIP, unzip, and move Encore.app to Applications. SHA256SUMS contains its checksum. Installed copies update themselves.

Encore is not notarized yet. [Apple's first-launch instructions](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102445). History is unencrypted; files are references; embedded payloads are limited to 25 MiB.
